tier.description: The run plans, one per GPU class and purpose.

ImageFlavour.description: The image a tier's pod boots.

oneOf.description:
`ghcr.io/zaitrarrio/fastvideo-rs-runtime:sha-<7>`: fv-gpucheck,
fv-lab, scripts/gpu and the CUDA runtime (docker/gpucheck.Dockerfile
`runtime`).

Tier.description: One `[[tier]]`: a run plan on one GPU class (a `runpod-matrix.sh` family).

cell_timeout_s.description: Per-arm cap (s), `timeout --kill-after=15` around each command; 0 = none.

cells.description: The cell files (`lab/cells/<name>.toml`), in run order.

gpu_count.description: GPUs per pod (1: the runner drives one GPU).

max_usd_per_hr.description:
Price cap ($/hr): a quote over it is never created; a pod billed over
it is deleted at once (fv-deploy's guard).

name.description:
The family name (`fv-lab run <name>`; the run directory
`runs/<name>/<tag>` and `artifacts/runpod/<name>/<tag>`).

preflight.description:
`verify-weights.sh` cells the pod checks at start into `weights.log`
(a report only: each arm gates on its own cell).

region.description: fv-control's region id (`eu`: the only one with a weights volume).

tae.description:
Fetch the tiny autoencoders (`fetch-tae.sh`) onto the container disk
at start, as `runpod-http.sh` does unless `FV_SKIP_TAE=1`.

wall_cap_s.description: Wall-clock cap (s): the detached backstop deletes the pod then.

TierProvider.description:
Where a tier's pods come from. Runpod pods only today (plan C3b adds
Vast and GCP to the `Provider` trait).

WeightsSource.description:
Where the weights come from (fv-boot's `FV_WEIGHTS_SOURCE`, ADR-0014 §3.3).
C3a launches `volume` only (the region guard's rule); the other sources
are typed so the schema does not change when they are allowed.
